text: - **Served pages and the stand's unit tests:** `tests/blitz-tests` holds two checks on the pages the stand serves beside the lean four, each declaring `mod session_common;` and no `mod fixtures;`, each test in both layout modes, picked up by `run stand` and the stand-repeat leg by their prefix — `stand_cells_served` 4, on the stand's own Cells (`stand::boot_cells`, a screen of 47,949 bytes in 740 lines, 5 parts of `SNAPSHOT_TEXT_BUDGET`) through `Session::run`: Cells walked in parts through the driver (`cells_is_walked_in_parts_through_the_driver`, v020-09's witness); committed cells reading their values and a cell past the viewport read in the last part; a click right after a `scroll` landing on the shown overlay scrollbar, so the walk takes `advance 5000` before its click; the lint at boot reading its measured findings — and `stand_load_page` 2, on the load page (`stand::boot_load`): a click on `load-fetch` waiting out the load `LoadNet` answers after 200 ms and `load-done` showing "Loaded" (`the_load_page_click_waits_out_its_load_and_shows_the_message`, v020-07's witness), and the page keyed with no lint finding at boot (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:91-209; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_load_page.rs:34-84 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)

text: - **The flight booker's select and the host's part read:** `stand_snapshot` reads the flight booker's `flight-type` as `ComboBox` "Flight type", value `one-way`, holding its two `ListBoxOption`s, one selected, each at the select's client rect (`the_flight_type_select_holds_its_two_options`, tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot.rs:122-170); seven_guis' `host_log` reads a paged part of a served Cells screen through the `escher-session` host's own sink — `serve cells` at `RUST_LOG=trace` in `hl-cells`, a sentinel committed into a part-2 cell first, then `snapshot --part 2`, 0 id and 0 name needles under both builds (`a_cells_part_read_through_the_host_logs_no_id_and_no_name_at_trace`, examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:134-277)
